title: 第455章 执法堂怎么一个人都没有第454章 全都去支援曹立
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
执法堂地牢的阵纹还亮着。
门开了，里面空荡荡的。
值守桌上放着半碗没喝完的茶。
登记册摊开，钥牌挂在墙上，但狱卒，一个没有。
曹立站在门口，脸上带着几分纳闷。“狱卒也没了？”
刘清河趴在地上，忍不住开口。“你们执法堂这管理……挺有特色。”
曹立也疑惑，继续拖着人往里走，今天实在是太古怪了。
绳子摩擦石板，声音一路往下传，很快，牢房里的犯人全被惊动了。
韩越第一个探头。“这么快回来了？”
“看看！”
不少犯人探着脑袋，这一看，所有人懵了。
“是曹立，曹立回来了。”
“曹立回来了？”
周小满从角落里爬起来，扒着栏杆往外看。
金长鸣本来靠在墙上养伤，听到动静，懒洋洋抬了一下头。“又抓人回来了吗？”
下一刻，七个人被曹立拖进通道。
地牢里先是安静半息。
然后炸了。
韩越整个人贴到栏杆上。“那是……刘清河？”
周小满眼珠子都快瞪出来。“丹峰刘长老？”

旁边牢房里有人失声。
“许承岳！”
“那不是丹峰许长老吗？”
“还有丹峰那几个八品长老！”
“我的天，曹立把丹峰长老串回来了？”
金长鸣本来还想装沉稳，结果看清绳子最后那个人，差点把栏杆掰断。
“等等！”
“最后那个是谁？”
韩越嗓子都破音了。“白白白白……白尊？”
周小满直接往后坐了一下。“圣子？那是圣子？曹立把圣子也绑了？”
整个地牢瞬间乱成一锅粥。
“疯了吧！”
“他出去一趟，不仅丹峰的刘清河给抓了？”
“就连圣子也被抓回来了？”
“丹峰这是被端了吗？”
“刘清河，许承岳，几个八品长老，还有白尊……这哪里是抓人，这是翻天啊！”
content_en:
The formation patterns in the Law Enforcement Hall dungeon are still on.
The door opened and it was empty.
There was a half-empty bowl of tea on the duty table.
The register was open, the key tags were hanging on the wall, but there was no jailer.
Cao Li stood at the door with a bit of confusion on his face. "The jailer is gone too?"
Liu Qinghe lay on the ground and couldn't help but speak. "The management of your Law Enforcement Hall...is quite unique."
Cao Li was also confused and continued to drag people inside. Today was really weird.
The rope rubbed against the stone slab, and the sound spread all the way down. Soon, all the prisoners in the cell were alarmed.
Han Yue was the first to probe. "Come back so soon?"
"Look!"
Many prisoners poked their heads, and everyone was stunned when they saw it.
"It's Cao Li, Cao Li is back."
"Cao Li is back?"
Zhou Xiaoman climbed up from the corner, holding on to the railing and looking out.
Jin Changming was leaning against the wall to recover from his injuries. When he heard the movement, he lazily raised his head. "Are you arresting people again?"
The next moment, seven people were dragged into the passage by Cao Li.
The dungeon was quiet for a while.
Then it exploded.
Han Yue pressed his whole body against the railing. "That's...Liu Qinghe?"
Zhou Xiaoman's eyes almost popped out of his head. "Elder Danfeng Liu?"
Someone in the nearby cell lost his voice.
"Xu Chengyue!"
"Isn't that Elder Xu of Danfeng?"
"And those eighth-grade elders from Danfeng!"
"Oh my god, did Cao Li bring Elder Danfeng back?"
Jin Changming originally wanted to pretend to be calm, but when he saw the person at the end of the rope, he almost broke the railing.
"Wait!"
"Who was that last one?"
Han Yue's voice broke. "Bai Bai Bai Bai... Bai Zun?"
Zhou Xiaoman sat back directly. "The Holy Son? Is that the Holy Son? Cao Li also tied up the Holy Son?"
The entire dungeon instantly became a mess.
"Go crazy!"
"When he went out, not only Liu Qinghe from Danfeng was arrested?"
"Even the Holy Son was captured?"
"Is Danfeng being taken away?"
"Liu Qinghe, Xu Chengyue, a few eighth-grade elders, and Bai Zun... this is not arresting people, this is going to change the world!"
